items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, sure, and we're still friends.

ctx.x: Yeah, sure, and we're still friends. I saw him last time I was in here, in New York, he came by to see me in several places, you know, at the Tin Palace, he came by the West End. Still the same guy like when we first saw each other, you know. Oh, then Kalil, the drummer, he worked with me at the Paradise, after Tim Kennedy left. And he changed his name too. But we're still friends. I haven't seen him.
